title: Sideways shift experiment: six ways (A-F)
intro: Reset Scripts first. Stand still in the open near the pawns, hands off. The camera may slide during some letters. Remember which letters moved it and whether nametags flickered.

steps.text: Hands off - co-op OFF. Don't touch anything; watch if the camera slides sideways.

steps.each_frame:
if not CAMX then
  CAMX = { cfg = {} }
  local function setx(p, f, x) local v = p:get_field(f); v.x, v.y, v.z = x, 0.0, 0.0; p:set_field(f, v) end
  local function bump(obj, f, key, x)
    local v = obj:get_field(f)
    local last = CAMX[key]
    if last and math.abs(v.x - last) < 0.0005 then return end   -- game did not recompute: don't add twice
    v.x = v.x + x; obj:set_field(f, v); CAMX[key] = v.x
  end
  CAMX.apply = function(late)
    local c = CAMX.cfg
    local mc = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"):call("getMainCameraController", 0)
    local cur = mc and mc:call("get_CurrentCameraController")
    if not cur then return end
    local env, act = cur:call("get_EnvironmentalOffsetParam"), cur:call("get_ActionOffsetParam")
    if c.touch_env then setx(env, "_POG", c.env_pog or 0.0); setx(env, "_Position", c.env_pos or 0.0) end
    if c.touch_act then setx(act, "_POG", c.act_pog or 0.0); setx(act, "_Position", c.act_pos or 0.0) end
    if late and c.direct then bump(cur, "_Pog", "k_pog", c.direct); bump(cur, "_Position", "k_pos", c.direct) end
    if late and c.main then bump(mc, "_Position", "k_main", c.main) end
  end
  re.on_pre_application_entry("UpdateBehavior", function() pcall(CAMX.apply, false) end)
end
